title: floc-consistency pipeline parameters
description: Consistency of floc clustering across batch sizes, checked against pairwise SNP distances

assemblies.description: Directory of assemblies (.fa, .fasta, .fna, optionally .gz). Sample names are file names without extensions.

outdir.description: Output directory (use a bucket path, e.g. s3://..., on Seqera Platform).

distance_matrix.description: Optional all-vs-all SNP distance matrix; when given, SKA2 is skipped. Long form (sample_a, sample_b, distance, e.g. a previous run's distances/ska_distances.tsv) or a square matrix with a header row of sample names. Tab-, comma- or space-separated, optionally gzipped. Sample names must match the assembly file names without extensions.

batch_sizes.description: Comma-separated batch sizes, e.g. '10,50'. Overrides start/step/stop. The all-samples reference run is always added.

start.description: Smallest batch size (when batch_sizes is not set).

step.description: Increase between batch sizes (when batch_sizes is not set).

stop.description: Largest batch size before the reference run (default: number of samples).

max_samples.description: Randomly select at most this many assemblies (seeded with seed) and use only them for every step. 0 uses every assembly.

shuffle.description: Shuffle the sample order (one order is used for every batch size).

floc_args.description: Extra floc options for every call, e.g. '-d 0.03 --min-hash-frac 0 --assign-metric avg'. Do not include -o or inputs.

core.description: pairwise: SNPs in split k-mers shared by each pair; global: only split k-mers present in every sample.

snp_threshold.description: Pairs with fewer SNPs than this are flagged when floc places them in different clusters.
